calibration.note: Anisotropic: y stretched ~7.6x vs x. Visual taper angles / S-bend deflections are far gentler in real um than the image suggests. All reasoning below is from direct per-column pixel measurement, not visual impression.

how_it_works: Light enters the single wide CENTRAL waveguide on the left. Over the coupling region the central guide is adiabatically tapered DOWN to a narrow tip while two symmetric OUTER waveguides (born as narrow tips at the coupler entrance) are tapered UP to full width, at a constant sub-wavelength gap. As widths trade off continuously, the fundamental mode of the central guide evolves adiabatically into the symmetric supermode of the two outer guides, transferring power 50/50 without a sharp junction. Past the coupler the central guide has vanished and the two outer guides carry equal power; they are then routed apart by S-bends to two well-separated output ports. Run in reverse it is a 2x1 combiner. Being mode-evolution based it is broadband and fabrication tolerant.

central_waveguide.taper: linear width 0.27 -> ~0.06 (near-tip) over ~22.4um, centered at device center

outer_waveguides.role: power acceptors -> the two outputs; symmetric about center
outer_waveguides.taper: linear width 0.06 -> 0.244 over ~22.4um (up-taper), UP-tapers complementary to central DOWN-taper

coupling_gap.note: measured 0.10-0.11 and ~constant along the coupler because w_central+w_outer stays ~0.31um (complementary tapers). This near-constant gap is the coupler's coupling-strength knob.

output_straights.note: outer edges land at +/-0.85um = the footprint half-height, so outputs graze the top/bottom edges; output pitch = 1.456um = 1.7 - w_wg

function_knobs.gap_um: coupling gap (edge-to-edge) -> coupling strength; drives outer-arm placement
function_knobs.L_couple: adiabatic coupling/taper length -> adiabaticity & bandwidth (the critical knob)
function_knobs.w_center_tip: central taper tip width (adiabatic mode donor endpoint)
function_knobs.out_offset: output waveguide center offset -> output port pitch
function_knobs.delta_length: output-arm length imbalance (routing/phase knob, default 0 = symmetric). This is the knob keyed by the measurement contract (lengths.json delta_length_um = |arm_top - arm_bottom|); at 0 the silhouette is symmetric as drawn.

why_not_alternatives.Y_branch: no wide multimode stem splitting at a hard junction; instead a central guide that tapers to a tip flanked by up-tapering guides => mode evolution, not a Y-split
why_not_alternatives.directional_coupler_2wg: three guides present in the coupling region (central + 2 outer), not two parallel identical guides
why_not_alternatives.MMI: no wide multimode slab; sub-wavelength guides throughout
why_not_alternatives.conclusion: central down-taper + symmetric outer up-tapers at constant gap + S-bend fan-out = textbook adiabatic (mode-evolution) 1x2 splitter

build_plan.primitives: gf.components.straight(cross_section) + gf.components.taper + gf.Path->extrude for S-bends + @gf.cell assembly; layer (1,0); no device stencils; no raw polygons
build_plan.coordinate_frame: build x in [0,40], symmetric about y=0 (compare_absolute left-aligns x, centers y). Target GDS bbox 40x1.7um for size_match.
build_plan.arm_lengths_for_contract: arm_top/arm_bottom = L_couple + sbend_path_len + (L_out[+delta_length]); delta_length_um computed as |arm_top-arm_bottom| from real objects

iterations.change_made: Initial build: central input straight + linear down-taper to tip; two symmetric outer up-tapers at fixed gap-derived offset; cosine S-bends fanning out to symmetric outputs; layer (1,0); bbox 40x1.7. Already >0.85.

Per-column diff fixes: (a) shift coupler section up ~0.0125um (target coupler symmetric about y~0.837, outputs about center); (b) S-bend start x=25.5->26 and run 26->36 to match measured cosine; (c) widen outer/central tips (w_outer_tip 0.06->0.07, w_center_tip 0.06->0.075). IoU 0.868->0.957.

Sharpen central donor tip with a second point-taper (0.076->0.02 over 0.5um) removing the ~757px blunt end-face; trim output guide width w_wg 0.244->0.242 (target outputs run ~0.24) and w_outer_tip->0.064; snap all widths to 0.002um grid (kfactory port rule). IoU 0.957->0.961.

stop_reason: IoU 0.961 >> 0.85 target after 3/6 iterations. Remaining residual is a ~<=6px S-bend easing difference (target inflection slightly right-skewed vs symmetric cosine) and sub-pixel edge anti-aliasing -- rasterization-level, not device physics. Stopped to avoid overfitting the rendered PNG.
write_note: device.gds written with with_metadata=False so the device cell stays top-level (no $$$CONTEXT_INFO$$$ wrapper); required for gdstk-based area/bbox measurement (verify_knob_response, _layer_area) to see the polygons. Geometry/IoU unaffected.

knob_verification.why_this_knob: delta_length (output-arm length imbalance) is the routing/phase knob the measurement contract keys on: it is the only tunable that moves lengths.json delta_length_um, and it cleanly extends one straight output guide of width w_wg, so area grows by width_um*delta_um. The splitting-physics knobs (L_couple, gap_um) are also top-level tunables but do not map to an arm-length delta.
